prompt:
Virtual staging of a real property photo: show this exact space after renovation.

Keep identical: camera position and angle, lens, room geometry, wall positions,
window and door openings, ceiling height and beams, the overall layout.
Change only finishes, fixtures, fittings and furniture, as described here:
Modern and warm kitchen refresh. Keep unchanged: the U-shaped layout and all cabinet positions and sizes, the peninsula and its raised ledge, the black sink and tap, the black gas hob, the window, the large light-grey floor tiles, the ceiling, beam and ceiling fans. Fronts: base units in handle-less matte warm greige (cashmere) with slim recessed grips; wall cabinets and the tall unit in light natural oak veneer; the black glass top row replaced with matching oak fronts; the missing doors under the sink added in the same greige. Worktop: warm white quartz with subtle soft veining, about 2 cm thick, also on the peninsula ledge. Walls: smooth matte warm off-white paint; the glossy splashback between worktop and wall cabinets replaced with warm white handmade-look rectangular tiles. Lighting: warm-white (2700 K) LED strip under the wall cabinets, two simple brass-and-opal-glass pendants over the peninsula, existing ceiling spots in warm white. No extra furniture or appliances; keep the worktop clear apart from a few small items.

Remove clutter, construction debris, personal belongings and anything that could
identify the occupants. Photorealistic, natural daylight, realistic materials and
proportions, no text or watermarks.
